attributes.action: The need to regulate AI & AI infrastructure in the UK.
attributes.additional_details: AI Data Centres are corrupting the local networks , harming water conditions and further costing the UK taxpayer even more money to sustain a stable and clean lifestyle. With AI in the mix , there will be less human input on immediate things for example healthcare , shopping , fitness. AI can self-navigate itself , causing unknowing consequences if this is not regulated or atleast closely monitored within day-to-day life. This is an immediate issue which does not have enough awareness.
attributes.background: I believe that AI poses a significant risk to UK citizens within the next 10 years if it continues at the pace that it is going. To protect our livelihood and local areas , we should pressure the government to regulate AI and imply more restrictions against Data Centres which are affecting everyone.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. We are not sure exactly what kind of regulation you want to see introduced and what the impact of this would be. 

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.

There are also already a number of petitions on this issue that you may wish to sign:

Increase safeguarding & human oversight regulation of Artificial Intelligence
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766308

Convene relevant parties to seek agreement on international regulation of AI
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778923

Restrict data centre building & energy use 
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/780955

Require new data centres to be energy net zero via local production
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779556

Independent environmental impact assessment for data centres & make AI opt-in 
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776179

Ban the construction of new AI data centres 
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776517
